title: The Red-Eyed Stranger
summary: Ha-Jun, Captain Baek, and Min-Jae infiltrate the subterranean ruins of Vault 7 beneath Incheon harbor, uncovering Dr. Victor Vance's nightmarish synthetic demon laboratory.

panels.shot: incheon harbor industrial docks in dense foggy midnight
panels.action: Massive rusted cargo cranes loom like metal dinosaurs in the thick ocean fog over Incheon shipping canal.
panels.prose_en: Massive rusted cargo cranes loom like metal dinosaurs in the thick ocean fog over Incheon shipping canal.
panels.prose_hi: Inchiyon shipping nahar ke upar ghane samudri kohre mein vishal jung lage malvahak crane dhatu ke dinosaur ki tarah mandra rahe han.

panels.shot: captain baek cutting through chain link fence with wire cutters
panels.action: Captain Baek in civilian tactical combat gear snips an electrified chain-link fence bearing 'RESTRICTED HAZMAT' signs.

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Official records say Vault 7 was flooded in 2021. In reality, Vance took it off the grid.

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek in civilian tactical combat gear snips an electrified chain-link fence bearing 'RESTRICTED HAZMAT' signs.
panels.prose_hi: Nagarik samrik ladaku gear mein captain bak 'pratibandhit khtarnak' sanketon wali ek vidyutikrit chen-link baad ko kaat deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun and min-jae slipping through the breached fence
panels.action: Ha-Jun slips through smoothly, coat billowed by ocean wind; Min-Jae follows with suppressed assault rifle ready.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slips through smoothly, coat billowed by ocean wind; Min-Jae follows with suppressed assault rifle ready.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aasani se fisal jata hai, coat samudri hawa se ud jata hai; min-je dabi hui assault rifle ke saath taiyar hokar chalta hai.

panels.shot: kuro scouting ahead from top of rusted shipping container
panels.action: Kuro glides from container to container: 'The air down below smells of rotting demon marrow and formaldehyde.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Biochemical waste aur demon flesh... Yahan bohot buri cheezein bani hain.

panels.prose_en: Kuro glides from container to container: 'The air down below smells of rotting demon marrow and formaldehyde.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ek container se dusre container mein sarkata hai: 'niche ki hawa mein sadte danav majja aur formeldehyd ki gandh aa rahi hai.'

panels.shot: discovering hidden hydraulic blast doors inside warehouse 9
panels.action: Inside an empty grain warehouse, Captain Baek sweeps away gravel to reveal a twenty-ton reinforced blast door in the floor.
panels.prose_en: Inside an empty grain warehouse, Captain Baek sweeps away gravel to reveal a twenty-ton reinforced blast door in the floor.
panels.prose_hi: Ek khali anaaj godam ke ander, captain bak farsh mein bees ton ka prabalit blast darwaja dikhane ke liye bajri hatate han.

panels.shot: baek overriding electronic console with military decryptor
panels.action: Baek plugs a military cipher-chip into the rusted keypad; green strings of decrypted code scroll down the monitor.

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Old Section 9 master bypass still works. We're going down three hundred meters.

panels.prose_en: Baek plugs a military cipher-chip into the rusted keypad; green strings of decrypted code scroll down the monitor.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ek sainya sifar-chip ko jung lage keypad mein plug karta hai; decripted code ke hare taar monitor ko neeche scroll karte han.

panels.shot: massive circular blast door unlocking with hiss of pressurized steam
panels.action: Locking pins retract with deafening pneumatic clunks; heavy steam vents as the floor hatch splits open.
panels.prose_en: Locking pins retract with deafening pneumatic clunks; heavy steam vents as the floor hatch splits open.
panels.prose_hi: Locking pin bahre kar dene wale vayviy clank ke saath peeche hat jaate han; jaise hi farsh ki hatch khulti hai bhari bhaap nikalti hai.

panels.shot: endless industrial freight elevator descending into blackness
panels.action: An open-grate industrial elevator platform rattles downward into a colossal vertical subterranean shaft.
panels.prose_en: An open-grate industrial elevator platform rattles downward into a colossal vertical subterranean shaft.
panels.prose_hi: Ek khuli jaali wala audyogik elevator platform ek vishal udhrvadhar bhumigat shaft mein neeche ki or khadkhadata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaning over railing observing glowing green vents below
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks down into the abyss: pipes glowing with sickly neon-green luminescent fluids crisscross the rock walls.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun hyung ko iss andhere mein saat saal rakha gaya...

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks down into the abyss: pipes glowing with sickly neon-green luminescent fluids crisscross the rock walls.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun neeche rasatal mein dekhta hai: bimar niyan-hare luminsent taral padarth ke saath chamakte pipe chattan ki diwaron ko paar karte han.

panels.shot: elevator clanking to halt at sublevel 7 arrival bay
panels.action: The lift hits the bottom with a shuddering metallic thud; emergency red exit lights flicker weakly along the tunnel.
panels.prose_en: The lift hits the bottom with a shuddering metallic thud; emergency red exit lights flicker weakly along the tunnel.
panels.prose_hi: Lift kanpkanpa dene wali dhatvik gadgdahat ke saath neeche se takrati hai; surang ke kinare aapatkalin lal nikas lightein dhimi gati se timtimati han.

panels.shot: trio advancing with flashlights through flooded medical hallway
panels.action: Ankle-deep murky water covers the linoleum floor; abandoned gurneys and broken IV stands clutter the corridor.
panels.prose_en: Ankle-deep murky water covers the linoleum floor; abandoned gurneys and broken IV stands clutter the corridor.
panels.prose_hi: Tuckne tak gehra ganda pani linoleum farsh ko dhak leta hai; parityakt garni aur toote hue IV stand galiyare ko avyavasthit karte han.

panels.shot: min-jae flashlight illuminating cracked stasis tube
panels.action: Min-Jae's flashlight beam reveals a cracked glass cylinder containing the preserved claw of an abyssal demon.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Look at these tanks... They were harvesting live demon organs.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae's flashlight beam reveals a cracked glass cylinder containing the preserved claw of an abyssal demon.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ki torch kiran se ek toote hue kaanch ke cylinder ka pata chalta hai jisme ek rasatal danav ka sanrakshit panja hai.

panels.shot: baek pointing to bloody drag marks on wall
panels.action: Baek points to five deep claw gouges carved into the concrete wall: 'Something broke out of quarantine recently.'
panels.prose_en: Baek points to five deep claw gouges carved into the concrete wall: 'Something broke out of quarantine recently.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek concrete ki deewar mein ukere gaye paanch gahre panjon ke nishanon ki or ishara karte han: 'hal hi mein sangrodh se kuch toot gaya.'

panels.shot: distant sound of heavy metallic footfalls echoing
panels.action: THUD... THUD... THUD... The sound of hydraulic piston legs echoes from the central operating theater ahead.
panels.prose_en: THUD... THUD... THUD... The sound of hydraulic piston legs echoes from the central operating theater ahead.
panels.prose_hi: Thad... thad... thad... hydraulic piston legs ki awaz aage ke central operating theater se goonjati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising fist signaling squad to halt
panels.action: Ha-Jun signals to stop; his violet eyes pierce through the darkness, detecting two hostile mana signatures.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Samne do heavy cyborg guards hain. Let me handle them quietly.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun signals to stop; his violet eyes pierce through the darkness, detecting two hostile mana signatures.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun rukne ka sanket deta hai; uski baingani aankhen andhere ko chirti hui do shatrutapurn man hastaksharon ka pata lagati han.

panels.shot: two section 9 chimera guards patrolling corridor junction
panels.action: Two 8-foot tall cyborg sentinels with chain-guns mounted on their shoulders and demon skull helmets patrol the turn.
panels.prose_en: Two 8-foot tall cyborg sentinels with chain-guns mounted on their shoulders and demon skull helmets patrol the turn.
panels.prose_hi: Kandhe par chen-banduken lagaye hue aur danav khopdi helmet ke saath do 8-fut lambe siborg prahari mod par gasht karte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun dissolving into shadow mist using chains of ruin
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward and melts into the floor shadows, leaving behind ethereal black and purple smoke.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps forward and melts into the floor shadows, leaving behind ethereal black and purple smoke.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aage badhta hai aur farsh ki chhaya mein pighal jata hai, aur apne peeche alaukik kala aur baingani dhuan chhod jata hai.

panels.shot: black chains erupting from water binding first guard legs
panels.action: Chains of Ruin burst from the ankle-deep water, wrapping around the first sentinel's metal joints with bone-crushing force.
panels.prose_en: Chains of Ruin burst from the ankle-deep water, wrapping around the first sentinel's metal joints with bone-crushing force.
panels.prose_hi: Ruin ki janjeeren takhne tak gahre pani se footati han, jo pehle prahari ke dhatu ke jodon ko haddi-kuchalne wale bal ke saath lapetati han.

panels.shot: ha-jun appearing behind second guard with blood blade
panels.action: Ha-Jun materializes directly behind the second cyborg, his Sanguine Fang already drawn in an execution arc.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun materializes directly behind the second cyborg, his Sanguine Fang already drawn in an execution arc.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun sidhe dusre siborg ke peeche sakar hota hai, uska senguin feng pehle se hi ek nishpaadan chaap mein khincha gaya hai.

panels.shot: clean decapitation of both chimera sentinels simultaneously
panels.action: A single fluid horizontal slash decapitates both sentinels cleanly; severed hydraulic lines spray spark and blue fluid.
panels.prose_en: A single fluid horizontal slash decapitates both sentinels cleanly; severed hydraulic lines spray spark and blue fluid.
panels.prose_hi: Ek ekal drav kshaitij slash donon prahari ko safai se nasht kar deta hai; kati hui hydraulic lainen chingari aur neela taral padarth chhidakti han.

panels.shot: both metallic corpses splashing heavily into the flooded water
panels.action: The two heavy cyborg torsos collapse into the water with a heavy splash, immediately silenced.
panels.prose_en: The two heavy cyborg torsos collapse into the water with a heavy splash, immediately silenced.
panels.prose_hi: Bhari chhinton ke saath do bhari siborg dhad pani mein gir gaye, turant shant ho gaye.

panels.shot: baek and min-jae jogging up with impressed whistles
panels.action: Min-Jae lowers his rifle: 'Damn, Ha-Jun. You didn't even let them make a radio call.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Flawless takedown. The main lab is right past that blast door.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae lowers his rifle: 'Damn, Ha-Jun. You didn't even let them make a radio call.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne apni rifle neeche ki: 'are, ha-jun. aapne unhen radio call bhi nahin karne di.'

panels.shot: entering the central operating theater: project chimera hub
panels.action: They enter a massive circular dome with dozens of server banks, dissecting tables, and a central command desk.
panels.prose_en: They enter a massive circular dome with dozens of server banks, dissecting tables, and a central command desk.
panels.prose_hi: Ve darjanon server bankon, vichchhedan talikaon aur ek kendriya command desk ke saath ek vishal golakar gumbad mein pravesh karte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun approaching the central holographic archive terminal
panels.action: Ha-Jun approaches the primary terminal, marked with Dr. Victor Vance's private biometric hand-scanner.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun approaches the primary terminal, marked with Dr. Victor Vance's private biometric hand-scanner.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun prathmik terminal ke paas pahunchta hai, jise do. victor vens ke niji biometric hand-scanner se chinhit kiya gaya hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun overriding biometric scanner with sovereign blood
panels.action: Ha-Jun presses his bloody thumb against the scanner; his Sovereign blood forces a root-level administrative breach.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Terminal unlocked. Search query: Kang Tae-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun presses his bloody thumb against the scanner; his Sovereign blood forces a root-level administrative breach.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne khoon se sane anguthe ko scanner par dabata hai; uska samprabhu rakt jad star ke prashasnik ullanghan ko majboor karta hai.

panels.shot: terminal monitor flashing green: 'SUBJECT ZERO ARCHIVE FOUND'
panels.action: The screen flashes with a high-resolution photo of a 16-year-old Tae-Jun strapped into an experimental neural chair.
panels.prose_en: The screen flashes with a high-resolution photo of a 16-year-old Tae-Jun strapped into an experimental neural chair.
panels.prose_hi: Scrin par ek prayogik neural kursi par bandhi 16 varshiya taaye-jun ki ucch-resolution wali tasveer chamakti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun reading medical logs of excruciating experiments
panels.action: Text logs scroll: 'Day 412: Extracted 500cc Sovereign bone marrow. Subject refused to scream. Kept repeating his brother's name.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mera naam... Wo har dard ke waqt mera naam leta raha...

panels.prose_en: Text logs scroll: 'Day 412: Extracted 500cc Sovereign bone marrow. Subject refused to scream. Kept repeating his brother's name.'.
panels.prose_hi: Text log scrol: 'din 412: 500 cc sovereign asthi majja nikala gaya. vishay ne chillane se inkar kar diya. apne bhai ka naam dohrata raha.'

panels.shot: room lights suddenly turning blood-red as siren blares
panels.action: A harsh crimson strobe light begins rotating; a deafening Klaxon siren wails through the facility speakers.
panels.prose_en: A harsh crimson strobe light begins rotating; a deafening Klaxon siren wails through the facility speakers.
panels.prose_hi: Ek kathor crimson strobe prakash ghumne lagta hai; suvidha speaker ke madhyam se ek bahra kar dene wala claxon siren bajta hai.

panels.shot: a high-definition video monitor powering on: dr. victor vance
panels.action: The giant wall screen boots up: an elderly man with silver slicked hair, a cybernetic crimson left eye, and a cruel smirk appears.

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: Welcome to Vault 7, young Ha-Jun Kang. I have awaited the Sovereign's true heir for seven years.

panels.prose_en: The giant wall screen boots up: an elderly man with silver slicked hair, a cybernetic crimson left eye, and a cruel smirk appears.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal deewar screen chalu hoti hai: chandi ke chikne bal, cybernetic lal rang ki bayin aankh aur ek krur muskurahat wala ek bujurg vyakti dikhai deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun glaring with murderous sovereign eyes at the screen
panels.action: Ha-Jun's teeth bared, purple mana cracking the floor tiles: 'Vance. Tell me where my brother is before I rip this bunker in half.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: DR. VANCE!! MERI AANKHON KE SAMNE AA, COWARD!!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's teeth bared, purple mana cracking the floor tiles: 'Vance. Tell me where my brother is before I rip this bunker in half.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke daant khule hue han, baingani man farsh ki tilein tod raha hai: 'vence. isse pehle ki main is bunker ko aadha tod dun, mujhe batao ki mera bhai kahan hai.'
